title: Zelensky to join European leaders in Cyprus as EU unblocks €90bn Ukraine loan
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky is scheduled to meet with EU leaders Thursday in Cyprus as the bloc prepares to approve a €90 billion loan for Ukraine, ending a prolonged deadlock.
